description: Source code for tensor factory functions and memory management specific to Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including tensor creation, resizing, and zero tensor allocation.

methods.name: maybe_resize_storage_mps
methods.description: Resizes the storage of a tensor if needed, handling memory allocation and copying for MPS tensors.

methods.name: resize_impl_mps_
methods.description: Resizes tensor implementation with specified size and stride, updating storage accordingly.

methods.name: empty_mps
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor on MPS device with specified properties.

methods.name: empty_strided_mps
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor with specified size and stride on MPS device.

methods.name: resize_mps_
methods.description: Resizes a tensor in-place on MPS device, with optional memory format.

methods.name: set_mps_
methods.description: Sets a tensor to an empty storage on MPS device.

methods.name: set_storage_mps_
methods.description: Sets storage, size, and stride for a tensor on MPS device.

methods.name: _efficientzerotensor_mps
methods.description: Creates a zero-initialized tensor on MPS device with specified size and dtype.
